column1: # Expected rows of the product object-load run (README.md).
# Rebuilt from the test sources: shared_product_node_attached_test.go,
# build-product.sh, verdict-load and the identity and hygiene rows of
# guest.sh. One stream per (group, step, profile):
# results/<group>/<step>__<profile>.json. The judge keeps the rows of the
# -profiles set; a "-" profile is always kept. Each row needs exactly one
# pass and no skip or fail; anything not listed here is an unexpected row
# build: the workstation that builds the bundle, no special kernel.
# kernel: the test machine's own kernel (any kernel the product gate
# admits), as root. The identity rows record the kernel; none compares it
